critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:640-641 — reassign updates tasks.assignee_id and leads.owner_id but does not touch stored 'assignee'/'owner' name fields for records where those denormalized names were stamped at creation via a different code path than assignee_id. If any legacy record has assignee set by name only (no assignee_id), it will not be reassigned. Consider matching by assignee_id OR by assignee-name = from_member.name during reassign; or migrate to always resolve via id at read time.

backend/server.py:654-655 — /my-work groups by ($or assignee_id/assignee/created_by). The 'assignee' name match is brittle if two workspace users share a first+last name; prefer id-only when assignee_id is present.

TeamTab.js remove-member confirm still shows fallback string; previous iteration flagged 'undefined will lose access' — verified now shows correct name because current code uses `${removing?.name || 'This member'}`. Bug from iter5 appears fixed.

Reassign dialog target Select includes the source member's owner-role name badge but not the invited-member himself (correctly filtered via `m.id !== reassigning?.id`). Consider also filtering out members with role 'owner' if business rule disallows reassigning to owner — currently owner is a valid target, which is fine.
